thread:
Harper: Heads-up: Olive the office tortoise completed a slow-motion desk crawl and is currently napping under @Rafael's monitor. pic: https://i.imgur.com/olive-turtle.jpg
Rafael: Nooooo my badge is missing and I think Olive found it. Shes wearing it like a floppy necklace. :turtle:
June: I thought the badge was a new decorative shell pattern for a second. Classic Olive.
Harper: She left a trail of tiny leaf crumbs leading from the plant by reception to Rafael's desk. Evidence attached (crumb-map.jpg).
Rafael: Security-bot, is a tortoise allowed to badge into the break room? Asking for a friend.
security-bot: Reminder: Only authorized personnel and service animals may access secure areas. Non-human visitors should be escorted by facilities.
June: Olive is low-key very authorized. She completed POP quiz (Pea On Patrol) last week.
Harper: @office-bot could we get a "Found: badge" on the lost-and-found board? Also maybe a tiny tortoise-sized harness so Olive doesn't wander into meeting rooms.
office-bot: Lost item reported: staff badge (Rafael). Facilities notified regarding animal harness options. Please avoid handling animals without permission.
Rafael: Update: I carefully coaxed Olive out with a lettuce leaf and retrieved the badge. No harm done. Photo of the rescue up next. (rescued-badge.jpg)
June: 10/10 rescue operation. Should we have Olive lead next week's welcome tour? :sparkles:
Harper: Proposal: "Olive Orientation" — she inspects new desks and refuses any with bad coffee. Vote: yes/no?
Rafael: YES. Also, does anyone have a tiny name tag for her? "Olive, Chief Crumb Inspector" seems accurate.
security-bot: Please ensure any animal involvement in workplace activities complies with health and safety guidelines. Facilities to advise on props.
June: Closing note: Olive's nap schedule = peak productivity distraction. Bring cameras. :camera_with_flash:
